cells.gaps: No fact shows a system past its pilot outside Addis Ababa: the July 2026 presentation does not say which rollout phase had been reached, and the offices facts disagree (pilot in ETH-003, ETH-011, ETH-016 and ETH-023; count:50 in ETH-013, an announced start in the capital with no total; count:100 in ETH-027, capital only, 2018). The connected facts do not say the entry is made at the office, and ETH-015 (2025-07) calls registration mainly paper-based. Finance is not stated for the eCRVS, and the only finance fact in the window is donor support to ME-CRVS (ETH-025, 2023). Whether the birth feeds the Fayda number is stated only as a possibility in systems.csv, so identity integrated is not set.
cells.note: Every digital system on record is either called a pilot (national eCRVS phase 1, ME-CRVS in 1,300 of 19,202 kebeles) or runs in the capital only, which the ladder places at stage 2. Stage 3 needs a system past its pilot and live in local offices beyond the capital, and no fact says so.
